question: Should ClawHub support a public Verified or vetted-community path for third-party plugins like Spectyra, and what scope, criteria, workflow, and revocation semantics should that signal have?
rationale: This affects user trust in third-party executable plugins and cannot be safely inferred from the current Official, trustedPublisher, scan, or release verification primitives.

options.title: Define a vetted-community path
options.body: Create a distinct policy and workflow for reviewed community plugins, including package-versus-publisher scope, evidence requirements, review authority, expiry, and revocation.

options.title: Keep Official-only endorsement
options.body: Document that community plugins can use source/provenance and scan evidence but cannot request a Verified badge unless maintainers explicitly mark the publisher Official.

options.title: Pilot evidence first
options.body: Land a carefully scoped plugin evidence endpoint before deciding whether any public Verified or vetted-community badge should exist.

recommendation.title: Define a vetted-community path
recommendation.body: Create a distinct policy and workflow for reviewed community plugins, including package-versus-publisher scope, evidence requirements, review authority, expiry, and revocation.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and related PR discussion make them the strongest routing candidate for the Official publisher and plugin trust surface.
